title: Bind to localhost by default and widen only when peers are consented
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. bind_address is derived: loopback until a consented LAN peer or remote client needs more. Tests zc_bind_auto_*.
